name: Xeno-canto
description: Xeno-canto focal bird recordings, more than 800 thousand cuts across more than 10 thousand species. Class-mean average precision and AUROC under a focal-to-soundscape shift. The Macaulay Library, more than one million recordings, is a companion note in this record. Audio not vendored.
